Lead PM — Consumer Lending, Berlin hybrid.

Kredo (Berlin, 70 people, Series B) runs an instalment-loan app for German consumers and is growing revenue 3x a year. We're hiring a Lead PM to own the loan-application funnel: underwriting decisions, pricing tests on APR tiers and activation of approved customers. You'll lead two PMs and report to the CPO. Hybrid in Berlin, two days a week; relocation support offered within Europe. Fluent German (C1) is required — all customer research and regulator correspondence is in German.
